title: Discover Fika for Substack - Growth built through appreciation
emailSubject: Discover Fika for Substack — Growth built through appreciation
emailContent:
For a long time, I wanted to build something special for my community, where people can feel genuinely appreciated for their content.

I invite you to try Fika for Substack and share your feedback, so you can enjoy new features and shape this application.

Fika for Substack enables you, as a reader or writer, to have a cozy virtual space where you can offer your admiration to someone else in a sweet way 🍰, using the Swedish 'Fika' concept — a break filled with cakes, baked goods and coffee.

Discover how you can use the app:

- Every week, a fresh cake with 12 slices appears
- You take a slice by leaving a small note of appreciation for someone whose content made an impact in your life
- It can be a writer you follow, a fellow reader, a friend, the host (that's me 😊), or just "the table"
- A public appreciation wall keeps every slice forever
- The cake resets every week, but the appreciation wall builds up week by week

No accounts, no signup, no follower counts.

Check out the app at Fika for Substack and follow @StefsDevNotes to receive more updates and news about its development.

Thank you,

Stefania
description:
This email was written for Stefania Barabas, as part of an email campaign aiming to promote her newly built application - "Fika for Substack". 

In this introductory email, I invited users to try the app through a friendly language, explaining the main features clearly and concisely.

title: New at Fika for Substack - Preview link and Download
emailContent:
Hi there,

First of all, a massive "THANK YOU ❤️" for your feedback.

Because of this, I've just released two improvements in Fika for Substack, aimed at answering your requests and providing you a better user experience.

[CTA - Explore Fika for Substack]

What's new in Fika for Substack:

Preview link — A flagship feature allowing you to open the shareable note in a new tab, alongside three new actions.

To use it, create a note and in the appearing modal, select "Preview link". On the new tab, you can select to:

- Copy note & open Substack — copies the note's message plus a shareable link to the clipboard, then opens Substack in a new tab, so the user can paste it into a note.

- Pass a slice to someone — a call-to-action directing the user back into the "Pour a coffee, take a slice" flow and enabling them to take a slice.

- Subscribe to the person who received the note — if the recipient maps to a Substack profile, a direct link to their page is showcased.

Download — this feature enables you to share your slice to other social media channels, or save it as an image for yourself.

Fika for Substack is evolving with you, so join me in building new features. I'd appreciate it if you could help by providing feedback using this form.

Until next time,
Stefania
description:
The second email in "Fika for Substack" promotional email campaign.

The copy detailed two new important features of the application. The open rate of the email (and engagement) improved from 39.7% to 51.8%.

title: Landing page copy - Anki
description:
Anki is a fictional application created as a case study. 

My scope was creating a landing page for it, including the software's description, main features and a pricing plan. 

The copy means to engage the users with the app's cutting edge features and spark their curiosity, driving the user base and increasing sales rapidly, due to a rich and affordable membership.
